data: What is the F1 score when the number of speakers is 2, as indicated by the height of the blue bar?

The blue bar represents the F1(Speaker as input) score. The height of the blue bar at the second column corresponds to the F1 score when the number of speakers is 2. From the figure, the height of the blue bar at this point appears to be approximately 80%. Therefore, the F1 score when the number of speakers is 2 is around 80%.
